releaseNotes: v1.5.0: dynamic multi-phase AI status indicator (sending/thinking/receiving/tool/processing) replacing the static spinner; streaming SSE with idle watchdog in both providers (no more flat 120s timeout — active streaming never times out); active-option indicator (● current) in all selectors; Add Custom Provider directly in /provider menu with interactive flow (name/base URL/secret API key/optional default model), edit/delete supported, all OpenAI-compatible; long-term memory always stored summarized (never raw) with auto-summary every 3 user messages and 'updating memory' status; conversation rename via /rename and /conversation menu; all config changes persist globally via ConfigManager; /clear fully resets chat context (not only screen); notices print above the input line with status line redrawn.
